verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs list a first-party Schedule trigger for workflows. A community comment about execution limits ("30s for cron") implies cron-style scheduled runs, so the product delivers recurring scheduled execution, but the documented depth is thin. missing for 10: documented cron-expression syntax for the Schedule trigger, any evidence of timezone selection/control, independent hands-on corroboration of schedule configuration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: Today, we support the following triggers: ... HTTP / Webhook ... Schedule
